from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import Cut
from pocket_coffea.lib.categories import MultiCut, Cartesian

# Define jet multiplicity binning
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        Cut(
            name="4j",
            function=lambda events: events.JetGood.counts == 4
        ),
        Cut(
            name="5j",
            function=lambda events: events.JetGood.counts == 5
        ),
        Cut(
            name="6j",
            function=lambda events: events.JetGood.counts >= 6
        ),
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        Cut(
            name="2b",
            function=lambda events: events.BJet.counts == 2
        ),
        Cut(
            name="3b",
            function=lambda events: events.BJet.counts >= 3
        ),
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of jet and b-tag multiplicities
categories = Cartesian(
    name="analysis_categories",
    cuts=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)
